summary: Carney Butte, Umatilla County OR: 30-foot ODF steel lookout built 1952 or 1958 (sources differ); moved to Umatilla Army Depot as a guard tower in 1977.

facts.status_note: Tower moved from the butte to the Umatilla Army Depot in 1977 as a guard tower; no source says whether it still stands there, or describes the butte site now

events.note: Forest Lookouts: new lookout on a 30-foot steel tower 99% completed by the end of 1952; cab sealed and painted in 1953
Register gives 1958 for the 30-foot steel live-in tower; conflicts with the 1952 date on Forest Lookouts
firelookout.com lists Carol Wallace as known lookout personnel
Tower moved to the Umatilla Army Depot to serve as a guard tower
Registered July 27, 2011; nominated by Ray Kresek

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the tower was built in 1958. The Forest Lookouts page says the new lookout was nearly finished by the end of 1952 and the cab was sealed in 1953. Both are reported; the story does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: Brief record had only the 2011 registration; added the 1952/1958 build conflict, the 1954 staffing name, and the 1977 move. The tower's present location at the depot is not confirmed by any source read, so the story says so. The depot article (America's Engineers) is about clearance of 416 acres; it is used only for context on access, not as a claim that the tower is there. Used 1 WebSearch past the first (2 total) and about 6 page reads.
